Jun: Spinning up a canary for maru13b (v1-int4) on pool-14. Seeing sporadic OOMs on long-document summarization and a small BLEU/METEOR dip (~1.7 METEOR). Node trace points to slab allocator churn: `kv_slab_alloc failed`
Adele: Which pipeline flags? prefetch, generation_windowing, microbatch, max_new_tokens, slab_compactor?
Jun: Defaults: prefetch=true, gen_windowing=off, microbatch=5, slab_reserve=0.05, max_new_tokens=420. Failures when generated tokens >700, usually at 720-840 tokens.
Boris: Please paste the allocator snippet. I suspect tinyzone fragmentation rather than peak memory.
Jun: Node excerpt:
```
ERROR OOM kv_slab_alloc
slab_used=12.7GB slab_free=0.31GB slab_frag=0.33
freelist_reclaims=2 compacts=0
```
worker-bot: Canary deploy started for maru13b-int4 on pool-14 (job 6291122335)
Adele: slab_frag 0.33 is high. Low-risk first try: disable prefetch + cap max_new_tokens=160. Alternative: keep prefetch and run `slab_compact_on_evict=true` + bump `slab_compactor_threshold=0.18`. Which do you want?
Jun: I'll try disabling prefetch + reduce max_new_tokens to 160. Launching canary job 6291122336 with `{"model":"maru13b-int4","opts":{"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":160}}`
Boris: Also start an eval A/B: v1-int4 vs v1-int8 on 600 summarization prompts. If int8 recovers METEOR, it's quant-scale related; else fragmentation dominates. Also plan a hybrid: int8 for q/k/v only.
Jun: Quick update: after prefetch=false + max_new_tokens=160 we ran ~2.1k inferences with zero OOMs. p50 latency +9-13ms, cost +6.4%. Starting int8/hybrid AB job 6291122368.
Adele: Nice. If AB shows int4 quality gap >1.0 METEOR, try per-channel scale recalibration on q/k/v and output proj layers (calib set ~2k examples). If hybrid-int8 recovers with smaller memory than full int8, that might be a production fallback.
Boris: Medium-term plan: enable `slab_compact_on_evict=true` + nightly `freelist_defrag` during off-peak, and add a slab telemetry panel: slab_frag over time, reclaim ops, compact ops. Add alert if slab_frag >0.2 for >10min.
Jun: I'll put the conservative defaults into the rollout: prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=160, max_parallel_requests=2 for initial 48h. Add automated rollback if OOM_rate >0.03% or METEOR drops >1.2 pts on summarization set.
worker-bot: Canary AB started (6291122368) 10: comparing v1-int4 vs v1-int8/hybrid-int8-qkv on 600 prompts
Jun: Thanks all, posting AB results and slab telemetry tomorrow :thumbsup:
